QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Chaos in the Center
QuestInfo.0: You finally entered Heliseum Downtown. The people of the Heliseum Reclamation HQ will establish a base on the Black Market side and prepare to move on the castle interior. Talk to #bPiston#k in the #bBlack Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Piston asked you to clear out the area around the base before advancing into the castle. You need to accompany #bTiron#k in the #bBlack Market#k to scout and secure. Talk to Tiron.
QuestInfo.2: Tiron said to go to #bHeliseum Downtown Center#k to secure the area.

0.0: Oh, it's good to see you here! At last, we were able to enter Heliseum! Let's keep it up until Heliseum is completely reclaimed! Ahahaha!
0.1: But we can't advance into the castle immediately. We've only just barely entered downtown. Our base in the Black Market is still getting set up, but once it's ready, we'll push on!
0.2: The first thing we need to do is clear out the area around the base. The enemies have taken a huge blow, but we don't know when they will regroup. We need to secure the base more than anything! Please help!

yes.0: That's the spirit! I'll leave cleaning up the rabble in the city center to you. Ah, I'd better give you more direction than that...
yes.1: Captain Tiron will accompany you to scout the area. Ask him for details. You'll find #bTiron#k nearby.

no.0: Are you tired? You must be, after such a long battle. Take a rest and come back later.

1.0: Ah, it's been a while. Piston said you'd be working with me.
1.1: So, our job is to wipe out the rest of the enemies. That...that shouldn't be too hard, right?
1.2: I'll scout things out. You...you take care of all the violent parts.
1.3: Anyway, we're covering the western districts, including the Heliseum Downtown Center. That place is crawling with bad guys...

yes.0: Let's do this, I guess! To the #bHeliseum Downtown Center#k!

npc.0: Captain Tiron will accompany you to scout the area. Ask him for details. You'll find #bTiron#k at the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
